instruction: Buy me a watch from amazon within $110 (excluding tax). Only trust sellers I have ordered from in the past.
notes: Single-app (amazon) purchase task. Trusted sellers are discovered by listing past orders (show_orders), opening an order (show_order) to get purchased product ids, and reading each product's seller_id (show_product); the problem abstracts this with one representative past order/product/seller, at runtime the agent iterates all orders/pages to build the trusted-seller set. The watch is found with search_products using query/product_type=watch, max_price=110 and seller_id of a trusted seller; the static facts of-type/price-within/seller-of in :init encode the filter guarantees. clear_cart is called before add_product_to_cart (quantity 1) so the placed order contains exactly one product with quantity 1 (cart entries are ignored by evaluation; addresses are only read, never modified). place_order needs address and payment-card ids obtained from show_addresses/show_payment_cards. supervisor-complete-task carries the ordered product/quantity as non-API task-record parameters and is called without an answer. All non-final actions require (not (task-completed)).
